about: Journeys between consecutive itinerary stops, looked up once (not live). Public-transport minutes are door-to-door including walking, for the stated weekday and departure time; they vary by time of day, day of week and service changes. Walking routes follow streets and footpaths. A route's own `source` overrides the default. Berlin: VBB timetable data via https://v6.vbb.transport.rest, for every hop of 1.5 km or more; Tempelhofer Feld is routed via its Tempelhofer Damm main entrance (Tor 10); Restaurant Anhalt shares the Deutsches Technikmuseum's location, so its journey is the museum's. Singapore: the Transitous journey planner (https://transitous.org, MOTIS) on 2026-10-12, using LTA timetable data for buses and MRT and OpenStreetMap for walking; hops of 1.5 km or more, plus Marina Bay walks where the street route is much longer than the straight line; Singapore Botanic Gardens is routed from Tanglin Gate; National Kitchen shares National Gallery Singapore's location. Hong Kong: Transitous on 2026-10-14 (MTR, bus and Star Ferry timetable data; OpenStreetMap for walking), for Wednesday 21 Oct 2026; Central walks are street-routed because of the hills. The Ngong Ping 360 cable-car ride is not in the timetable data and its duration is not published as text by the operator, so that hop is left untimed. Paris: Transitous on 2026-10-14 (RATP/RER timetable data; OpenStreetMap for walking), for Wednesday 4 Nov 2026; every hop is stored, as street-routed walks or timetabled journeys. Le Jules Verne shares the Eiffel Tower location. London: Transitous on 2026-10-14 (TfL Underground and bus timetable data; OpenStreetMap for walking), for Wednesday 4 Nov 2026; every hop is stored.
